title: Use Go-to function to reposition an AGV (not in a task) to a target map cell (e.g., Hospital)
summary: If an AGV is in the green state (ready to execute something) but not currently in a task, use the OptiSweep/HMI Robot Selection “Go-to” function to send it to a selected target square/cell on the map. For recovery scenarios where WCS needs the AGV/tote binding to be reinitialized, the segment describes removing and adding the AGV so the tote is in a “question mark” state, then sending the AGV to the hospital via Go-to so the tote can be dropped there; once the tote is removed at the hospital, the AGV drops, reinitializes, and returns to pick up a new tote.
when_to_use: Use when an AGV is not in a task (green state) and you need to quickly reposition it to a target map cell/square using the Go-to function. Use the hospital drop-off example when the goal is to help WCS reinitialize the AGV by ensuring the tote is removed at the hospital and then the AGV can pick up a new tote.
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Execute the Go-to repositioning steps on the OptiSweep/HMI Robot Selection interface and perform the described remove/add recovery sequence when needed for WCS reinitialization behavior.
access_or_tools_needed: Access to the OptiSweep/HMI screen that supports Robot Selection and the Go-to function
Ability to select an AGV and interact with the map/cells to choose a destination square
Ability to remove and add the AGV/tote as described in the segment (for the reinitialization example)

access_required: OptiSweep/HMI access to Robot Selection and Go-to controls
system_preconditions: Target AGV is in the green state and not currently in a task (ready to execute something, but no task)

visual_references.description: Robot Selection / Go-to recovery example frame showing the question-mark tote context and the Go-to flow (select AGV, Go-to, target selection, Confirm).
Robot Selection Go-to function frame listing the 4-step flow: Select an AGV, Select Go to, Select which square, Select Confirm.

steps.title: Identify an AGV that is in the green state and not currently in a task
steps.purpose: Confirm the AGV is eligible for Go-to repositioning (ready but not assigned to a current task).
steps.instruction: On the OptiSweep/HMI Robot Selection interface, locate an AGV that is in the green state and indicates it is not currently in a task.
steps.expected_result: The selected AGV is shown as green (idle/not in a task) and has no current task assignment.
steps.healthy_condition: AGV status is green and it is not in a task (idle/ready state).
steps.failure_condition: The AGV is not green or is already in a task (Go-to repositioning is not the intended action for an AGV currently executing a task).

actions.label: Verify AGV is green and not in a task
actions.exact_action: Select/identify the AGV in the Robot Selection panel and verify it is in the green state (not in a task).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: If an AGV is in the green state, that means it's ready to execute something, but it doesn't have a task.

steps.title: Select the AGV in the Robot Selection area
steps.purpose: Set the correct AGV as the target for the Go-to command.
steps.instruction: In the OptiSweep/HMI Robot Selection area, select the AGV you identified in Step 1.
steps.expected_result: The chosen AGV is selected in the Robot Selection panel (so subsequent Go-to actions apply to that AGV).
steps.healthy_condition: The AGV selection is active (the interface indicates the selected AGV).
steps.failure_condition: A different AGV is selected than intended, or no AGV selection is active before choosing Go-to.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR/slide text: Robot Selection; Go-to function steps: 1) Select an AGV 2) Select Go to 3) Select which square you want the AGV to go to 4) Select Confirm.

steps.title: Select the Go-to function
steps.purpose: Open the Go-to workflow for manual repositioning of an AGV not in a task.
steps.instruction: After selecting the AGV, choose the “Go to” / Go-to function in the Robot Selection workflow.
steps.expected_result: The Go-to workflow is active and prompts for a target square/cell (or otherwise prepares for target selection).
steps.healthy_condition: Go-to is selected for the chosen AGV and the UI is ready for target selection.
steps.failure_condition: Go-to is not selected or the UI does not prompt for a target square/cell.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Select the AGV, select go to, then it will give you a target code where you want the AGVs to go (or you can click on the map itself).

steps.title: Choose the target square/cell (by target code or clicking the map)
steps.purpose: Define where the AGV should navigate using Go-to.
steps.instruction: When prompted for a target code/square, either (a) type/select the target code or (b) click directly on the map to choose the destination cell.
steps.expected_result: A specific target square/cell is selected as the Go-to destination for the chosen AGV.
steps.healthy_condition: The UI shows the selected target cell/square for the Go-to destination.
steps.failure_condition: No target cell/square is selected, or the wrong cell/square is selected before confirming.

actions.label: Select destination cell/square
actions.exact_action: Select which square you want the AGV to go to (click on the map cell or select the target code).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: You don't have to type the target code, you can click on the map itself. You can click on a cell and confirm and it will navigate to that location.
OCR/slide text: 3) Select which square you want the AGV to go to.

steps.title: Select Confirm to send the AGV to the selected location
steps.purpose: Execute the Go-to command so the AGV navigates to the chosen map cell/square.
steps.instruction: Select “Confirm” to send the AGV to the selected destination cell/square.
steps.expected_result: After selecting Confirm, the AGV navigates to the chosen map cell/square.
steps.healthy_condition: AGV begins moving toward the selected destination cell/square after Confirm.
steps.failure_condition: AGV does not navigate as expected after Confirm (no movement / remains unable to proceed).
stop_or_escalate_if: If the AGV does not pick up a task after the remove/add + Go-to recovery sequence, escalate for further WCS/AGV troubleshooting.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Select Confirm to navigate. After selecting Confirm, it will navigate to that location.

steps.title: Recovery example: remove/add AGV to make tote “question mark”, then Go-to the hospital for drop/reinitialize
steps.purpose: Use the hospital as a drop-off location so the AGV can drop, reinitialize, and pick up a new tote; also address WCS reinitialization behavior tied to tote binding state.
steps.instruction: If this Go-to action is part of recovery after a connectivity/binding issue: remove and add the AGV so the tote is in the “question mark” state, then send the AGV to the hospital using Go-to. After the tote is removed at the hospital, the AGV drops, reinitializes, and comes back to pick up a new tote.
steps.expected_result: Once the tote is removed at the hospital, the AGV drops, reinitializes, and returns to pick up a new tote.
steps.healthy_condition: Tote is removed at the hospital and the AGV transitions through drop/reinitialize behavior and then is able to pick up a new tote/task.
steps.failure_condition: WCS does not reinitialize the AGV until the tote is removed and added again; if the AGV remains unable to leave / does not reinitialize, escalate for further WCS/AGV troubleshooting.

actions.label: Remove and add AGV to create question-mark tote state
actions.exact_action: Remove the AGV and add it back so the totes now are in the question mark state.

actions.label: Send AGV to hospital via Go-to
actions.exact_action: Use the go to function to drop it off at the hospital.

stop_or_escalate_if: If WCS does not reinitialize until the tote is removed and added again, repeat the remove/add behavior as described (tote must be removed and added to the AGV again) and then reattempt the hospital Go-to.
If recovery does not progress as described (AGV remains unable to leave / does not reinitialize), escalate for further WCS/AGV troubleshooting.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Example: remove the AGV and add it so the totes now in the question mark state; send a go to function to the hospital; once you remove the tote from at the hospital, it drops and reinitialize and comes back and picks up a new tote.
WCS will not reinitialize that AGV until the tote's removed and add it to the AGV again; if you remove and add it, it considers still binded, but it's like a not a proper binding.

success_criteria: After selecting Confirm, the AGV navigates to the chosen target map cell/square.
In the hospital recovery example: after the tote is removed at the hospital, the AGV drops, reinitializes, and returns to pick up a new tote.
healthy_conditions: AGV is green and not in a task before using Go-to.
Go-to destination cell/square is selected and Confirm is executed.
AGV movement begins toward the selected destination after Confirm.
For hospital recovery: tote removal at hospital is followed by AGV drop/reinitialize and ability to pick up a new tote.
failure_conditions: AGV does not pick up a task after remove/add and Go-to recovery sequence.
AGV remains unable to leave / does not reinitialize after the hospital Go-to.
WCS does not reinitialize because tote binding state is not properly reset (tote not removed and added again).
escalation_guidance: If the AGV does not pick up a task after the remove/add + Go-to sequence, escalate for further WCS/AGV troubleshooting.
If recovery does not progress as described (AGV remains unable to leave / does not reinitialize), escalate for further WCS/AGV troubleshooting.
